name: skip set-up
js: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Skip'); if (b) b.click(); return !!b; })()

name: open
js: (async () => { await window.GMMCDeploy.open(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); return { open: d.open, title: d.querySelector('.dp-title').textContent, cards: d.querySelectorAll('.dp-card').length, chips: d.querySelectorAll('.dp-groups .dp-fchip').length, tabs: d.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]').length }; })()

name: disabled targets
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); return ['docker', 'builtin', 'virtualbox', 'vmware', 'ssh', 'usb', 'rpi', 'pages', 'folder'].map((id) => { const c = d.querySelector('[data-target=' + id + ']'); const w = c.querySelector('.dp-why'); return { id, disabled: c.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').disabled, chip: c.querySelector('.dp-chip').textContent, why: w.hidden ? '' : w.textContent, link: w.hidden ? '' : c.querySelector('.dp-why-link').href }; }); })()

name: filter chips
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); const chip = (n) => Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.dp-groups .dp-fchip')).find((b) => b.textContent.trim().startsWith(n)); const shown = () => Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.dp-card')).filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.dataset.target); const out = {}; for (const n of ['Virtual machines', 'Flash a drive', 'On this computer', 'Online', 'All']) { chip(n).click(); out[n] = shown(); } return out; })()

name: zip deploy
zip contents
instances tab
js: (async () => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); document.getElementById('dp-tab-instances').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const rows = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.dp-irow')).map((r) => ({ name: r.querySelector('.dp-iname span').textContent, where: r.querySelector('.dp-iwhere').textContent, health: r.querySelector('.dp-ihealth').textContent, disabledStart: !r.querySelector('.dp-ib[title=Start]') })); const mb = d.querySelector('.dp-irow .dp-ib[aria-haspopup]'); mb.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const menu = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.dp-menu-i')).map((b) => b.textContent + (b.disabled ? ' (disabled: ' + b.title + ')' : '')); mb.click(); return { tab: document.getElementById('dp-tab-instances').textContent, rows, menu, empty: !!d.querySelector('.dp-empty') }; })()

name: remove asks first
js: (async () => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); const mb = d.querySelector('.dp-irow .dp-ib[aria-haspopup]'); mb.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.dp-menu-i')).find((b) => /^Remove/.test(b.textContent)).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const dlg = d.querySelector('.dp-modal[open]'); const text = dlg ? dlg.textContent : ''; Array.from(dlg.querySelectorAll('.dp-btn')).find((b) => b.textContent === 'Remove').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); return { dialog: text.slice(0, 200), rowsAfter: d.querySelectorAll('.dp-irow').length, stored: localStorage.getItem('gmmc.deploy.instances.v1') }; })()

name: pages validation
repo validation
js: (() => { const { parseRepo } = window.GMMCDeployCore; const bad = ['', 'a', 'a/b/c', 'a b/c', '../x', 'a/..'].map((x) => { try { parseRepo(x); return 'ACCEPTED ' + x; } catch { return 'rejected'; } }); const ok = parseRepo('https://github.com/Name/my-map.git'); return { bad, ok }; })()

name: cantonese
js: (async () => { window.I18N.setLang('yue'); await window.GMMCDeploy.open(); const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return { title: d.querySelector('.dp-title').textContent, docker: d.querySelector('[data-target=docker] .dp-why').textContent, btn: d.querySelector('.dp-deployAll').textContent, chip: d.querySelector('[data-target=docker] .dp-chip').textContent }; })()

name: overflow
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('deployDialog'); const dr = d.getBoundingClientRect(); const main = d.querySelector('.dp-pane'); const wide = []; for (const e of d.querySelectorAll('*')) { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width && (r.right > dr.right + 1 || r.left < dr.left - 1)) wide.push(e.className || e.tagName); } return { vw: innerWidth, dialogW: Math.round(dr.width), mainScrollW: main.scrollWidth, mainClientW: main.clientWidth, docScrollW: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, escaping: wide.slice(0, 8) }; })()
